# Recommended main-branch protection

Apply to `main` when repository administration settings are available:

- Require pull requests before merging
- Require the `docs / build-and-deploy` status check
- Require branch to be up to date before merging when practical
- Require at least one approval for collaborative maintenance
- Dismiss stale approvals after substantial updates
- Block force pushes
- Block branch deletion
- Allow repository administrators to bypass only for recovery
